about.title: Goleta Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision changes everything, and Goleta families are not immune to this reality — the city recorded a traffic death alongside 129 injury collisions in the most recent reporting year, many along corridors like Calle Real and Cathedral Oaks Road. California law gives surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children the first right to bring a wrongful death claim, with other dependents and heirs eligible in certain circumstances. These claims are separate from any criminal case tied to the same crash, and they exist to address the financial and emotional toll left behind: funeral and burial costs, lost income and support the deceased would have provided, and the loss of companionship and guidance. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves — we're a free service that connects grieving families with an independent attorney who can walk through the legal options, explain the two-year deadline, and handle the case on contingency so there's no upfront cost to your family.

whyChoose.title: Why Goleta Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Are Specific
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs become eligible. An attorney can clarify where your family fits before time becomes an issue.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Is Real
items.desc: Wrongful death claims generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and that window shortens significantly if a government entity is involved. Waiting to seek guidance can quietly cost a family its legal options.

items.title: Recoverable Losses Go Beyond Bills
items.desc: California law allows families to pursue funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance — not just economic damages. A knowledgeable attorney can help account for all of it.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in Goleta?
items.answer: Under California law, families generally have two years from the date of death to file. If a government agency, such as a public roadway authority, may be responsible, that deadline can be much shorter, so it's worth speaking with an attorney early.

items.question: Who is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim after a Santa Barbara County crash?
items.answer: California law gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, and children. If none of those exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing, and an attorney can explain how that applies to your family's specific situation.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free service, and we're not a law firm ourselves. The independent attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover compensation for your family.
